exercises.name: squat
coaching_cues: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out
Push your hips back as if sitting into a chair
Keep your knees tracking over your toes, not caving inward
Only go as low as you can without knee pain
safety_warnings: Stop immediately if you feel sharp pain in the knee
Do not let your knees collapse inward
Hold onto a chair or counter for balance if needed

warmup: March in place for 2 minutes, then do 10 slow heel raises and 10 gentle leg swings per side.
cooldown: Walk slowly for 1 minute, then hold a gentle standing quadriceps stretch for 30 seconds per leg.
overall_safety: This is a low-volume knee plan. Mild muscle effort is expected; joint pain is not. Stop and consult your physical therapist if pain increases during or after the session.
